notes: Placement groups and hibernation are the highest-yield pages: exam tasks 3.2 (high-performing compute placement) and 2.2 (failure isolation) map directly onto cluster vs spread vs partition trade-offs. Drill the numbers exactly: 7 instances per AZ per group (spread), up to 7 partitions per AZ, 10 Gbps for cluster with Enhanced Networking, 5 Elastic IPs per account, 150 GB RAM limit and 60-day hibernation cap. Typical distractors: spread described as unlimited or cross-Region, partition confused with spread, hibernate with instance store root or unencrypted root, Elastic IP described as fixed private IP. Elastic IP best practice (prefer DNS name or Load Balancer) is a recurring 'most appropriate architecture' answer.
